```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 10 — Spatial inferCNV cancer-spot classification
#==============================================================================
#
# Purpose:
#   Use completed inferCNV results to identify spatial spots with expression
#   patterns consistent with large-scale CNV alterations.
#
# Classification:
#   CNV burden:
#     mean(abs(inferCNV expression value - 1))
#
#   CNV-high threshold:
#     95th percentile of reference-spot CNV burden within each sample
#
#   Malignant-enriched:
#     observation spot AND CNV-high
#
# Visualization:
#   CNV burden is standardized relative to reference spots within each sample.
#   The z-score is used for visualization only and does not alter the
#   malignant-enriched classification.
#
# Notes:
#   inferCNV provides expression-based evidence consistent with large-scale
#   CNV alterations. It is not direct DNA-based evidence of malignancy.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(infercnv)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis settings

tumor_samples <- c(
  "Niacin_Treatment",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2"
)

sample_titles <- c(
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin B5",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle D5"
)

image_names <- c(
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin2_B5",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle1_C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle2_D5"
)

reference_label <- "reference"
observation_label <- "observation"

threshold_quantile <- 0.95


# UMAP CNV-burden palette

cnv_low_color <- "#2166AC"
cnv_mid_color <- "#FEE08B"
cnv_high_color <- "#B2182B"

cnv_z_limits <- c(-3, 3)


# Chromosome dosage palette
#
# This is directional:
# blue = lower inferred dosage
# white = approximately neutral
# red = higher inferred dosage

dosage_low_color <- "#2166AC"
dosage_mid_color <- "#F7F7F7"
dosage_high_color <- "#B2182B"


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

infercnv_directory <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "infercnv"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv",
  "cancer_spot_classification"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv",
  "cancer_spot_classification"
)

dir.create(
  results_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  figure_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


# Input files

master_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)

prepared_file <- file.path(
  infercnv_directory,
  "infercnv_prepared_spatial_objects.rds"
)

result_index_file <- file.path(
  infercnv_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_result_index.rds"
)


# Output object

output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_annotated.rds"
)


# Essential input checks

if (!file.exists(master_file)) {
  stop("Master spatial object was not found.")
}

if (!file.exists(prepared_file)) {
  stop("Prepared inferCNV spatial objects were not found.")
}

if (!file.exists(result_index_file)) {
  stop("inferCNV result index was not found.")
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load inferCNV results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object <- readRDS(
  master_file
)

prepared_objects <- readRDS(
  prepared_file
)

result_index <- readRDS(
  result_index_file
)

sample_objects <- prepared_objects$tumor_samples


missing_samples <- setdiff(
  tumor_samples,
  names(sample_objects)
)

if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing prepared tumor samples: ",
    paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}


infercnv_objects <- list()


for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {

  result_file <- result_index[[sample_name]]$result_file

  if (!file.exists(result_file)) {
    stop(
      "inferCNV result not found for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  infercnv_objects[[sample_name]] <- readRDS(
    result_file
  )
}


message(
  "Loaded inferCNV results for ",
  length(infercnv_objects),
  " tumor-bearing samples."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Score and classify spots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

score_infercnv <- function(
    infercnv_object,
    seurat_object
) {

  cnv_matrix <- infercnv_object@expr.data


  # Genome-wide deviation from neutral inferCNV value of 1

  cnv_score <- colMeans(
    abs(cnv_matrix - 1),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  common_spots <- intersect(
    names(cnv_score),
    colnames(seurat_object)
  )

  if (length(common_spots) == 0) {
    stop("No inferCNV barcodes matched the spatial object.")
  }


  groups <- seurat_object$infercnv_input_group[
    match(
      common_spots,
      colnames(seurat_object)
    )
  ]


  score_table <- data.frame(
    spot = common_spots,
    infercnv_score = cnv_score[common_spots],
    infercnv_input_group = groups,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  reference_scores <- score_table$infercnv_score[
    score_table$infercnv_input_group == reference_label
  ]

  if (length(reference_scores) == 0) {
    stop("No reference spots were available.")
  }


  # Reference-derived threshold used for classification

  threshold <- as.numeric(
    quantile(
      reference_scores,
      probs = threshold_quantile,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  score_table$infercnv_status <- ifelse(
    score_table$infercnv_score > threshold,
    "CNV-high",
    "CNV-low"
  )


  score_table$malignancy_annotation <- case_when(

    score_table$infercnv_input_group == observation_label &
      score_table$infercnv_status == "CNV-high" ~
      "Malignant-enriched",

    score_table$infercnv_input_group == observation_label &
      score_table$infercnv_status == "CNV-low" ~
      "Tumor-region CNV-low",

    score_table$infercnv_input_group == reference_label ~
      "Non-malignant reference",

    TRUE ~
      "Not assessed"
  )


  # Standardize CNV burden relative to reference spots.
  # This score is used for visualization only.

  reference_mean <- mean(
    reference_scores,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  reference_sd <- sd(
    reference_scores,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (is.na(reference_sd) || reference_sd == 0) {
    stop("Reference CNV burden has zero variance.")
  }


  score_table$infercnv_zscore <- (
    score_table$infercnv_score - reference_mean
  ) / reference_sd


  score_table$infercnv_threshold <- threshold

  return(score_table)
}


spot_results <- list()


for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {

  score_table <- score_infercnv(
    infercnv_objects[[sample_name]],
    sample_objects[[sample_name]]
  )

  score_table$sample <- sample_name

  spot_results[[sample_name]] <- score_table


  current_object <- sample_objects[[sample_name]]

  match_index <- match(
    colnames(current_object),
    score_table$spot
  )


  current_object$infercnv_score <- score_table$infercnv_score[
    match_index
  ]

  current_object$infercnv_zscore <- score_table$infercnv_zscore[
    match_index
  ]

  current_object$infercnv_threshold <- score_table$infercnv_threshold[
    match_index
  ]

  current_object$infercnv_status <- score_table$infercnv_status[
    match_index
  ]

  current_object$malignancy_annotation <-
    score_table$malignancy_annotation[
      match_index
    ]


  sample_objects[[sample_name]] <- current_object


  message(
    sample_titles[[sample_name]],
    ": threshold = ",
    signif(
      unique(score_table$infercnv_threshold),
      4
    ),
    "; malignant-enriched spots = ",
    sum(
      score_table$malignancy_annotation ==
        "Malignant-enriched"
    )
  )
}


all_spot_results <- bind_rows(
  spot_results
)


write.csv(
  all_spot_results,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_spot_classification.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


classification_summary <- all_spot_results %>%
  count(
    sample,
    malignancy_annotation,
    name = "spots"
  )


print(
  classification_summary
)


write.csv(
  classification_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_classification_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Visualize inferCNV classification
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

burden_plots <- list()
spatial_score_plots <- list()
malignancy_plots <- list()


for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {

  score_table <- spot_results[[sample_name]]

  current_object <- sample_objects[[sample_name]]

  threshold <- unique(
    score_table$infercnv_threshold
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CNV burden: reference versus observation
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  burden_plot <- ggplot(
    score_table,
    aes(
      x = infercnv_input_group,
      y = infercnv_score
    )
  ) +
    geom_violin(
      trim = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.15,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = threshold,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sample_titles[[sample_name]],
      subtitle = "Dashed line = reference 95th percentile",
      x = NULL,
      y = "inferCNV burden"
    ) +
    theme_bw(
      base_size = 12
    )


  print(
    burden_plot
  )


  ggsave(
    file.path(
      figure_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_infercnv_burden.png"
      )
    ),
    burden_plot,
    width = 6,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 600
  )


  burden_plots[[sample_name]] <- burden_plot


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spatial inferCNV burden
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_score_plot <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  current_object,
  features = "infercnv_zscore",
  images = image_names[[sample_name]],
  pt.size.factor = 1.6
) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      sample_titles[[sample_name]],
      " — inferCNV burden"
    )
  )


print(
  spatial_score_plot
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_spatial_infercnv_zscore.png"
    )
  ),
  spatial_score_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


spatial_score_plots[[sample_name]] <- spatial_score_plot

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Final spatial malignancy classification
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  malignancy_plot <- SpatialDimPlot(
    current_object,
    group.by = "malignancy_annotation",
    images = image_names[[sample_name]],
    pt.size.factor = 1.6
  ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_titles[[sample_name]],
        " — inferCNV classification"
      )
    )


  print(
    malignancy_plot
  )


  ggsave(
    file.path(
      figure_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_spatial_malignancy_classification.png"
      )
    ),
    malignancy_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )


  malignancy_plots[[sample_name]] <-
    malignancy_plot
}


# Combined overview plots

burden_overview <- wrap_plots(
  burden_plots,
  nrow = 1
)

spatial_score_overview <- wrap_plots(
  spatial_score_plots,
  nrow = 1
)

malignancy_overview <- wrap_plots(
  malignancy_plots,
  nrow = 1
)


print(
  burden_overview
)

print(
  spatial_score_overview
)

print(
  malignancy_overview
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "infercnv_burden_overview.png"
  ),
  burden_overview,
  width = 18,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_zscore_overview.png"
  ),
  spatial_score_overview,
  width = 20,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_malignancy_classification_overview.png"
  ),
  malignancy_overview,
  width = 20,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Evaluate final cancer-spot classification
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

classification_levels <- c(
  "Non-malignant reference",
  "Tumor-region CNV-low",
  "Malignant-enriched"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5A. CNV burden across final classifications
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

classification_plot_data <- all_spot_results %>%
  filter(
    malignancy_annotation %in%
      classification_levels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    malignancy_annotation = factor(
      malignancy_annotation,
      levels = classification_levels
    ),
    sample_label = factor(
      sample_titles[sample],
      levels = sample_titles[tumor_samples]
    )
  )

malignancy_colors <- c(
  "Malignant-enriched"       = "#F8766D",
  "Non-malignant reference"  = "#00BA38",
  "Tumor-region CNV-low"     = "#619CFF"
)

classification_burden_plot <- ggplot(
  classification_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = malignancy_annotation,
    y = infercnv_score,
    fill = malignancy_annotation
  )
) +
  
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.8,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.14,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ sample_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = malignancy_colors,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "inferCNV burden across final spot classifications",
    x = NULL,
    y = "inferCNV burden"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  
  theme(
    
    # Remove redundant x-axis labels
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    
    # Facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    # Compact legend above plot
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    
    # Reduce excess space around legend
    legend.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 0,
      b = 2,
      l = 0
    ),
    
    # Clean panel appearance
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )


classification_burden_plot


print(
  classification_burden_plot
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "infercnv_burden_by_final_classification.png"
  ),
  classification_burden_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5B. Classification composition by sample
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

composition_data <- classification_summary %>%
  filter(
    malignancy_annotation %in%
      classification_levels
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * spots / sum(spots)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    malignancy_annotation = factor(
      malignancy_annotation,
      levels = classification_levels
    ),
    sample_label = factor(
      sample_titles[sample],
      levels = sample_titles[tumor_samples]
    )
  )


classification_composition_plot <- ggplot(
  composition_data,
  aes(
    x = sample_label,
    y = percent,
    fill = malignancy_annotation
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "inferCNV classification composition by sample",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Spots (%)",
    fill = "Classification"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  )


print(
  classification_composition_plot
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "infercnv_classification_composition_by_sample.png"
  ),
  classification_composition_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Chromosome-level inferred CNV dosage
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

chromosome_results <- list()


for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {

  infercnv_object <-
    infercnv_objects[[sample_name]]

  current_object <-
    sample_objects[[sample_name]]

  cnv_matrix <- infercnv_object@expr.data

  gene_order <- infercnv_object@gene_order


  common_genes <- intersect(
    rownames(cnv_matrix),
    rownames(gene_order)
  )


  cnv_matrix <- cnv_matrix[
    common_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  gene_order <- gene_order[
    common_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  observation_spots <- colnames(
    current_object
  )[
    current_object$infercnv_input_group ==
      observation_label
  ]

  reference_spots <- colnames(
    current_object
  )[
    current_object$infercnv_input_group ==
      reference_label
  ]


  observation_spots <- intersect(
    observation_spots,
    colnames(cnv_matrix)
  )

  reference_spots <- intersect(
    reference_spots,
    colnames(cnv_matrix)
  )


  observation_mean <- rowMeans(
    cnv_matrix[
      ,
      observation_spots,
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  reference_mean <- rowMeans(
    cnv_matrix[
      ,
      reference_spots,
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  gene_dosage <- data.frame(
    gene = common_genes,
    chromosome = gene_order$chr,
    dosage_delta =
      observation_mean - reference_mean,
    sample = sample_titles[[sample_name]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  chromosome_results[[sample_name]] <-
    gene_dosage %>%
    group_by(
      chromosome,
      sample
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_dosage_delta = mean(
        dosage_delta,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      n_genes = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


chromosome_summary <- bind_rows(
  chromosome_results
)


chromosome_summary$chromosome <- factor(
  chromosome_summary$chromosome,
  levels = paste0(
    "chr",
    1:19
  )
)


write.csv(
  chromosome_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "chromosome_CNV_dosage_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Use symmetric limits around zero so gains and losses
# receive equivalent visual weight.

dosage_limit <- max(
  abs(
    chromosome_summary$mean_dosage_delta
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


chromosome_heatmap <- ggplot(
  chromosome_summary,
  aes(
    x = chromosome,
    y = sample,
    fill = mean_dosage_delta
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = dosage_low_color,
    mid = dosage_mid_color,
    high = dosage_high_color,
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(
      -dosage_limit,
      dosage_limit
    ),
    name = "CNV dosage\nΔ"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Chromosome-level inferred CNV dosage",
    subtitle = "Candidate tumor region relative to reference spots",
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )


print(
  chromosome_heatmap
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "chromosome_CNV_dosage_heatmap.png"
  ),
  chromosome_heatmap,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Transfer inferCNV classifications to the master object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object$infercnv_input_group <-
  "Not assessed"

spatial_object$infercnv_score <-
  NA_real_

spatial_object$infercnv_zscore <-
  NA_real_

spatial_object$infercnv_threshold <-
  NA_real_

spatial_object$infercnv_status <-
  "Not assessed"

spatial_object$malignancy_annotation <-
  "Not assessed"


for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {

  score_table <-
    spot_results[[sample_name]]


  master_spots <- colnames(
    spatial_object
  )[
    spatial_object$sample == sample_name
  ]


  # Remove sample prefixes before matching barcodes

  master_barcodes <- sub(
    "^[^_]+_",
    "",
    master_spots
  )

  result_barcodes <- sub(
    "^[^_]+_",
    "",
    score_table$spot
  )


  match_index <- match(
    master_barcodes,
    result_barcodes
  )

  matched <- !is.na(
    match_index
  )


  matched_master_spots <-
    master_spots[
      matched
    ]

  matched_results <-
    match_index[
      matched
    ]


  spatial_object$infercnv_input_group[
    matched_master_spots
  ] <- score_table$infercnv_input_group[
    matched_results
  ]


  spatial_object$infercnv_score[
    matched_master_spots
  ] <- score_table$infercnv_score[
    matched_results
  ]


  spatial_object$infercnv_zscore[
    matched_master_spots
  ] <- score_table$infercnv_zscore[
    matched_results
  ]


  spatial_object$infercnv_threshold[
    matched_master_spots
  ] <- score_table$infercnv_threshold[
    matched_results
  ]


  spatial_object$infercnv_status[
    matched_master_spots
  ] <- score_table$infercnv_status[
    matched_results
  ]


  spatial_object$malignancy_annotation[
    matched_master_spots
  ] <- score_table$malignancy_annotation[
    matched_results
  ]


  message(
    sample_name,
    ": transferred ",
    length(matched_master_spots),
    " inferCNV classifications."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. UMAP validation of cancer-spot classification
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"umap" %in% names(
  spatial_object@reductions
)) {
  stop("UMAP reduction was not found.")
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8A. Reference-standardized inferCNV burden
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

infercnv_zscore_umap <- FeaturePlot(
  spatial_object,
  features = "infercnv_zscore",
  reduction = "umap",
  pt.size = 0.7,
  order = TRUE
) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = cnv_low_color,
    mid = cnv_mid_color,
    high = cnv_high_color,
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = cnv_z_limits,
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "grey70",
    name = "Relative CNV\nburden (z-score)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reference-standardized inferCNV burden",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Standardized within each sample",
      "using reference spots"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )


print(
  infercnv_zscore_umap
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_UMAP_infercnv_reference_zscore.png"
  ),
  infercnv_zscore_umap,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8B. Full malignancy classification
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

malignancy_umap <- DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "malignancy_annotation",
  pt.size = 0.8
) +
  labs(
    title = "inferCNV-derived malignancy classification"
  )


print(
  malignancy_umap
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_UMAP_malignancy_classification.png"
  ),
  malignancy_umap,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8C. Highlight malignant-enriched spots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object$malignant_highlight <- ifelse(
  spatial_object$malignancy_annotation ==
    "Malignant-enriched",
  "Malignant-enriched",
  "Other spots"
)


spatial_object$malignant_highlight <- factor(
  spatial_object$malignant_highlight,
  levels = c(
    "Other spots",
    "Malignant-enriched"
  )
)


malignant_umap <- DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "malignant_highlight",
  cols = c(
    "Other spots" = "grey80",
    "Malignant-enriched" = "#D73027"
  ),
  pt.size = 0.7,
  order = "Malignant-enriched"
) +
  labs(
    title = "Malignant-enriched spatial spots",
    subtitle = paste(
      sum(
        spatial_object$malignant_highlight ==
          "Malignant-enriched"
      ),
      paste(
        "spots classified using tumor-region",
        "location and inferCNV burden"
      )
    ),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )


print(
  malignant_umap
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_UMAP_malignant_spots.png"
  ),
  malignant_umap,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save final object and metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  spatial_object,
  output_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


final_metadata <- spatial_object@meta.data

final_metadata$spot <- rownames(
  final_metadata
)


write.csv(
  final_metadata,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_final_metadata.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


classification_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "CNV_score",
    "CNV_high_threshold",
    "malignant_classification",
    "CNV_visualization"
  ),
  value = c(
    "mean(abs(inferCNV value - 1))",
    paste(
      "95th percentile of reference spots",
      "within each sample"
    ),
    "observation spot AND CNV-high",
    paste(
      "CNV burden standardized to reference",
      "mean and SD within each sample"
    )
  )
)


write.csv(
  classification_parameters,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_classification_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


n_cnv_high <- sum(
  spatial_object$infercnv_status ==
    "CNV-high",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_malignant <- sum(
  spatial_object$malignancy_annotation ==
    "Malignant-enriched",
  na.rm = TRUE
)


message(
  "Module 10 complete: ",
  n_cnv_high,
  " CNV-high spots; ",
  n_malignant,
  " malignant-enriched spots."
)
```
